title: Send for Krishna
hook: everyone in the hall says yes, and Yudhishthira still sends for Krishna, the friend who sees further
carry: krishna, the friend who sees further

segments.voice: Yesterday: Pandu's words, carried by Narada, asking his son to perform the Rajasuya. Your line was what we do still reaches the ancestors.
screen: `WHAT WE DO STILL REACHES THE ANCESTORS.`

segments.voice: Narada has one more thing to say before he goes. This sacrifice, he tells the king, is hard to finish. It has many obstacles. Brahma-rakshasas, demons who haunt sacrifices, look for any flaw in it. And after it, a war can come that destroys the warriors of the earth. Think it over, Narada says. Do what's good for you. Then he leaves, and the hall is left holding both halves of the message.
screen: `HARD TO FINISH.` → `DEMONS LOOK FOR FLAWS.` → `A WAR CAN COME AFTER.`

segments.voice: A dead father asking his son to rise to this. A sage warning that it might end in ruin. Yudhishthira brushes aside neither. The text says he sighed, and thought, and couldn't find peace. So he asks. First his ministers and his brothers: you deserve this, they say, do it. Then the priests and sages, Dhaumya, and Vyasa himself. They agree too. Everyone in the room says yes. And still Yudhishthira doesn't move. People who love you, he reasons, don't always point out the danger. Some say what pleases. So he thinks of the one who won't flatter him and sees further than anyone: Krishna. He sends a fast messenger to Dwaraka, and Krishna comes quickly. Here's why that matters to Hindus. Krishna isn't just a clever cousin. Many Hindus worship him as God himself, Vishnu come into the world, and the Mahabharata keeps showing him in one role above all: the friend at your side who sees what you can't. Devotees even have a name for loving God this way: sakhya, friendship, one of the moods of bhakti. Watch for it. Later in this serial, on a battlefield, Arjuna will turn to the same friend in his worst hour, and what Krishna says there becomes the Bhagavad Gita. Today is the small first version: a good king, surrounded by yeses, who still wants Krishna's eyes on it. Many Hindus still bring a big choice to God first, at the home shrine or the temple, before they decide. Tomorrow, Krishna answers.
screen: `A REQUEST AND A WARNING.` · `EVERYONE SAYS YES.` · `SEND FOR KRISHNA.` · `SAKHYA: GOD AS FRIEND.` · then, large: `THE FRIEND WHO SEES FURTHER.`

segments.voice: Think of a choice in front of you. If you have a home shrine or a picture of Krishna, sit in front of it; if not, just close your eyes. Say the choice plainly, out loud or inside, the way Yudhishthira laid it out for Krishna, and then stop talking and listen for a minute. If you pray, ask to see it the way Krishna would. If you don't, ask what the wisest person you know would see that you're missing.
Sabha. A hall full of counsel. Today, every voice in it says yes, and the king still sends for Krishna.
Your line: krishna, the friend who sees further. Everyone said yes, and the king still asked him. See you tomorrow.

howItsDone: Many Hindus keep a picture or murti of Krishna at the home shrine and bring big decisions there first; devotees speak of loving him as a friend, sakhya, one of the moods of bhakti.

Brahma-rakshasas.meaning: demons said to haunt sacrifices, hunting for flaws

Dwaraka.meaning: Krishna's city, where the messenger is sent

Krishna.meaning: the Pandavas' cousin and counselor, honored as God

sakhya.meaning: friendship; loving God as a friend

sources.ref: Mahabharata, Sabha Parva, Lokapala Sabhakhyana Parva (Narada's warning) and Rajasuyarambha Parva (Yudhishthira consults ministers, brothers, Dhaumya and Vyasa, and sends for Krishna)

notes: All paraphrase. Confirm Narada's warning: many obstacles, Brahma-rakshasas seeking flaws, and a war destroying kshatriyas after the sacrifice.
Confirm Yudhishthira consults ministers and brothers, then Dhaumya and Dvaipayana (Vyasa), who all approve.
Confirm Yudhishthira's reasoning that friends may not point out faults out of affection or self-interest before he sends for Krishna.
Confirm Krishna is sent for at Dwaraka (Dwaravati) and comes quickly.
